metrics.closure: |gap| = |native_delta - sum of terms| (rounding term) within floor = 2 x bf16 spacing at the larger |logit| of the two margin tokens over both runs
metrics.shares: direct, mlp (sum of captured c.Delta m), reread (sum c.Delta o, l>20), norm, each over native_delta; medians and IQR per arm
metrics.against_unbound: ablate arm: sum_l c.Delta m_l over the native Unbound embedding_mlp term (c.h_0 + sum over all 28 layers of c.m_l)
metrics.flip_set: a pair flips when M changes sign; predicted flip = sign(M0 + direct + mlp) != sign(M0); mismatch rate over the donor pairs (and the ablate pairs, reported)
metrics.spearman: Spearman rank of mlp against native_delta over the donor pairs
metrics.concentration: per (item, layer): top-8 |effect| share of sum |effect|; median over layers 20-27 and items
metrics.recurrence: an item's named neurons = its top 8 per layer (64 names); a neuron recurs in a country when named on >= 3 items of that country (8 countries have >= 3 panel items); null = the same count with country labels shuffled within the panel (200 shuffles, seed 0), reported as mean and the fraction of shuffles >= observed
metrics.linear_share: sum_l linear / sum_l exact (MLP) per pair; median
metrics.spectral: per (item, layer) on the donor arm: channel top-32-bin credit share, its permuted-channel control, and the neuron basis top-192 share; medians and the median paired difference native - permuted
